Do not sell or share my personal informationAccept AllCustomizeAllow SelectionDenySkip to contentAbout T-Mobile CenterT-Mobile Center is Kansas City’s home for concerts, sports, and special private events. Anchor to more than $8.5 billion of reinvestment in a revitalized downtown Kansas City, Mo., T-Mobile Center is a unique public/private partnership between the city of Kansas City and ASM Global/Legends. Since Opening on Oct. 10, 2007, T-Mobile Center has exceeded all expectations having exceeded attendance and financial projections in each year since opening in 2007. T-Mobile Center has provided nearly $9.3 million in unanticipated revenue to the City of Kansas City, Mo. through a revenue sharing provision in the arena management agreement. According to Pollstar Magazine’s Year End Report, T-Mobile Center has been recognized as America’s eighth busiest arena and No. 26 among Worldwide Venues.Save As Favorite Amenities Meeting Space
